beats: <firstname female :: hero>, the {knight|ranger|traveler}, {walked|came|limped} into the mountain inn after riding three nights without sleep. <firstname male :: liar>, the {liar|swindler|trickster}, {sat|waited|watched} beside the fire.
When <::hero> asked which road crossed the pass, <::liar> {said|muttered|whispered} that the bell-road was safe. He hid a smile when she thanked him.
Before dawn, <::hero> followed his directions because the snow had covered every other trail. At the first bell, the trees {bent closer|shut out the moon|began to whisper}.
<::hero> found six frozen travelers beneath the bell tower, each holding a coin from the inn. She turned back, though the bells rang without wind behind her.
At sunrise, <::hero> returned and laid the six coins before <::liar>. He {denied knowing them|called them worthless|swore they were stolen}, until the dead travelers knocked at the door.
<::hero> opened it. The dead {carried|dragged|led} <::liar> up the bell-road, and by nightfall his voice was ringing from the tower.
